candidates.hook: Juliana looks up at Alexander by the firelight and confesses: "I was frightened." Alexander: "Of them?" Juliana: "Of losing you."
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander suddenly catches Juliana's wrist mid-air as she reaches for his face, arresting her movement and telling her solemnly, "Not yet."
candidates.why: It delivers high-stakes romantic intimacy before halting on an abrupt boundary, making viewers desperate to know what secret Alexander is hiding.

candidates.hook: Nestled against Alexander's broad chest before the hearth, Juliana whispers, "Your heart is racing." Alexander responds: "So is yours."
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana's voiceover states the haunting mystery: "I know almost nothing about the man I married," cutting just before her reassurance.
candidates.why: A seductive, intimate embrace flips into suspicion and mystery with a voiceover reveal questioning the hero's hidden identity.

candidates.hook: Juliana looks up at scarred Alexander in the ruins: "For standing between me and those men." Alexander replies: "I would do it again."
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander kneels in the mud, clasping her bandaged hands and delivering an absolute vow: "No one will hurt you again." / "You cannot promise that." / "I just did."
candidates.why: Quickly establishes the dynamic of the stoic protector and traumatized heroine, paying off with a fierce, swoon-worthy vow of protection.

moments.desc: Alexander drops to one knee and firmly vows that as long as he draws breath, no one will ever hurt Juliana again.
Juliana confesses she wasn't scared of the thugs, but of losing Alexander, visibly shaking him with emotion.
Juliana reaches toward Alexander's face, but he stops her wrist mid-air with a solemn 'Not yet.'
Juliana's voiceover reflects while resting on his chest: 'I know almost nothing about the man I married.'
